name: Prima Assicurazioni
note: Title sponsor of Prima Pramac Yamaha MotoGP, confirmed again for the 2026 season (Yamaha Motor race release, 2026-01-14). Ownership not yet researched (prima.it blocks fetching). Prima Seguros, Prima's Spanish brand, is on the upper back of Real Betis's match shirt from 2025-26 to 2027-28 (club announcement, 2025-06-10).
